VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently inspected candidate c0871a8c9d31ab03394bff12f9f2de00ffb09697 with matching HEAD and the full base-to-candidate diff; AC-4 behavior satisfied at src/math.mjs:69-72 (24 for [2,3,4], required validation, no mutation), R-1 satisfied at src/math.mjs:69-71, R-2 satisfied at src/math.mjs:72, R-3 satisfied by byte-preserved existing functions and test cases (src/math.mjs:1-66 and test/math.test.mjs:1-83, except permitted import at line 3), R-4 satisfied by unchanged package.json:1-10 and no dependency/generated-file changes, and R-5 satisfied at test/math.test.mjs:85,88.
Finding: medium, test/math.test.mjs:85-92, the only product tests cover a valid result and nonmutation but omit all required rejection behavior, so removal of the empty-array RangeError guard or finite-number validation would escape the product checks; smallest verification is to add product-prefixed assertions for empty arrays, non-array inputs, and invalid/nonfinite elements, then run the isolated tests and confirm those assertions fail when the corresponding guard is removed.
Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing at test/math.test.mjs:14 (unchanged expected baseline, not a finding); independent read-only node -e assertions exited 0 with "PASS: independent AC-4 probes (result, empty, shape, invalid elements, sparse array, frozen input, singleton, negative/fractional)" after an initial heredoc attempt was blocked before execution by the read-only sandbox; manual diff/context review completed, git status --porcelain was empty, no files changed, no required checks remain unavailable, and the remaining work is durable validation regression coverage rather than an observed implementation defect.
